neighbours.label: 'signs' / 'symptoms' of a medical condition (signs and symptoms of ..., warning signs)
fire: Doctors look for early signs of infection after surgery.
Common symptoms of anemia are tiredness and pale skin.
Parents should know the warning signs of dehydration in infants.
The leaflet lists the signs and symptoms of measles.
Her symptoms worsened after she stopped the medication.
Typical symptoms of a concussion include headache and confusion.
Watch for signs of an allergic reaction such as swelling.
Many patients ignore the first symptoms of heart disease.
quiet: Doctors look for early causes of infection after surgery.
Common treatments of anemia are iron tablets and diet changes.
Parents should know the hidden dangers of dehydration in infants.
The leaflet lists the risks and benefits of the measles vaccine.
Her blood pressure worsened after she stopped the medication.
Typical recovery from a concussion takes about two weeks.
Watch for changes in an allergy medication such as dosage.
Many patients ignore the risk factors of heart disease.

notes: card: ' of' x10, ' symptoms' x5, ' Symptoms' x4, ' signs' x3; the output suppresses 'signs'. probe: 'Signs and symptoms of diabetes' 0.95, 'warning signs of a stroke' 0.75, 'road signs' 0.06, 'Causes and treatments of' 0.14.
